episodes.title: Surviving a Rehab Cult (feat. Dulce Mac) - You're Lucky To Be Here | Ep. 56
episodes.description:
Mason Smith is joined by comedian Dulce Mac to talk about her time spent in a cult disguised as a recovery center & shares some close calls on the Patreon!

Watch the rest of this episode with Dulce on Patreon:
https://www.patreon.com/masonsmithcomedy

Get Tickets to the first YLTBH Comedy Show! - https://vulcanatx.ticketsauce.com/e/lucky-to-be-here

Follow Dulce Mac: 
https://www.instagram.com/dulcemac/

Follow Mason Smith: 
https://www.instagram.com/masonsmithcomedian/

You're Lucky To Be Here is a wild & hilarious podcast hosted by stand up comedian Mason Smith. From comedians to artists & actors, guests share stories of times they almost lost it all, and why they're lucky to be here.
